benchmark.name: PHYBench

summary.en: PHYBench evaluates models on original physics problems spanning physical perception and multi-step reasoning.
summary.zh: PHYBench 评估模型解决原创物理问题、进行物理感知和多步推理的能力。

task_format.en: The model solves a fixed set of 500 original physics problems and submits answers checked by the benchmark's verification procedure.
task_format.zh: 模型需要解决固定的 500 道原创物理题，并提交由 benchmark verification procedure 检查的答案。

explanation.en: Accuracy is the fraction of the fixed PHYBench problems answered correctly. The benchmark also reports an EED score, but EED is a separate metric and is not merged here.
explanation.zh: Accuracy 是固定 PHYBench 题目中答对的比例。benchmark 还报告 EED score，但 EED 是独立 metric，本卡不将它合并。

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
